scores.label: A
scores.note: option 1 'cautious to' and 6 'wary to' are unidiomatic and weaken the fear; option 3 'timid to' is unidiomatic and describes temperament; options 8 and 10 'fearful of ...' are ungrammatical before 'to speak up' and add ideas; best options not first

scores.label: B
scores.note: option 2 'cowardly' adds a judgment and is unidiomatic with 'to'; option 4 'timid to' unidiomatic; option 8 'dreadful' is the wrong sense; option 9 'shy' trivializes the fear; option 10 'worried to' is unidiomatic

scores.label: C
scores.note: option 2 'intimidated to' is unidiomatic; option 5 'daring' is the opposite meaning; option 7 'ashamed' changes the meaning; option 8 'concerned to' means eager to; option 10 'timid to' unidiomatic; option 1 'terrified' overstates
